---
title: "Computer Vision (Visión Artificial) 2019-1"
---

This course introduces the fundamental concepts of computer vision, including image processing, camera models, feature extraction and matching, motion detection, object tracking, and image classification, with emphasis on practical applications and computational methods.     
ITM – Institución Universitaria @2019
